history.p: Three-way comparison of efficient attention mechanisms with SIX sequence positions. Panel local sparse attention: SIX-by-SIX connection grid with main diagonal and first neighboring diagonals shaded, exactly16 allowedpairs. Panel kernelized attention: SIX pairs of two-dimensional key/value features contribute outer products to ONE TWO-by-TWO accumulated summary matrix plus ONE TWO-coordinate key-sum vector; query-feature TWOcoordinates acts on summary and normalizes by querydotkeysum -> TWOoutput coordinates. Panel low-rank positional projection: SIX keys/values averaged into TWO slotvectors (firstthree / lastthree), SIX queries read TWO slots giving SIX-by-TWO reading grid. Distinct scientific approaches not identical softmaxrearrangement. Blank grids and numbers added later, panels equal visualweight, sparse flatmechanism symbols. Diagramlayout original.
